name: engineering_works_closure_notice
description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-68, near-boundary positive): the operator announces that a running line closes between two stations for a weekend of works.

candidates.title: Metro line closes between two stations this weekend for works
candidates.search_snippet: The operator announced a weekend closure of part of a running line.
candidates.source_content: The metro operator announced that the line will not run between two of its stations on Saturday and Sunday while track works take place. Replacement buses will serve the closed section, and trains will run on the rest of the line at the normal timetable.
